title: Constitutional Tribunal president Święczkowski suspended; police block court
detail: Judge Anna Korwin-Piotrowska announced the suspension of Tribunal president Bogdan Święczkowski and deputy Bartłomiej Sochański, saying it was needed to restore the rule of law. Justice Minister Waldemar Żurek sought to lift their immunity and Tusk defended the move. The Tribunal's own account called it a 'coup d'état' and said she could not act as interim head because the president had not sworn her in. Riot police blocked the building, PiS supporters protested and three people were arrested trying to enter. President Nawrocki cut short a trip to Senegal and returned to Warsaw.

media.caption: Riot police deployed outside Poland's Constitutional Tribunal
